description: Consumption contract (SG-33): the numeric estimate a consumer must read is exactly the top-level integer field `tokens`. This valid record pins that guarantee — `tokens` is present, is a non-negative integer, and re-derives as segmentation.cjkCharacters + segmentation.otherRuns. A consumer reading any other field (segmentation, input) for display is violating the frozen consumption contract that produced the `[object Object]` bug.
